story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Who were some other musicians that impressed you?
Well, Darnell Howard, Omer Simeon, saxophone.
Was Simeon on saxophone rather than clarinet?
Both. Yeah, he was a terror on both. Beautiful first sax.

No, he didn't, because -- I think it's because these records that he made with Jelly Roll became, you know, such classics, and he played such beautiful clarinet on them that, you know, a lot of people think that you can do one thing, then you can't possibly do something else.
But his work with Hines on albums.
I saw him with Jimmy Lunceford's band in the mid-forties. He was playing lead alto, I think. He didn't play much clarinet. That's the only time I ever
saw him. Yeah, he was a great saxophonist, but also a clarinetist.
Trying to think of some of the other great musicians.
